normalized_failures.expected_meaning: No caller-visible object or raw helper may authorize or perform external semantic loading; every semantic operation must itself begin from an execution root and perform the complete validation sequence.
normalized_failures.observed_meaning: Published preflight/control objects, the controls constructor, diagnostic schedule helper, and direct semantic helpers allowed semantic module execution before root-bound validation in both controller and verifier; 16 accepted direct-entry cases were recorded.

prior_reproducer_and_new_counterfactual_.prior_reproducer: Candidate-v18 emit-artifact and validate_artifact called schedule before controls.
prior_reproducer_and_new_counterfactual_.remaining_gap: The dispatcher relied on module-level capability objects and left raw semantic helpers callable.

prior_reproducer_and_new_counterfactual_.prior_reproducer: Invoke the published preflight/control objects, controls constructor, diagnostic schedule, or direct semantic helpers without a validated execution root.
prior_reproducer_and_new_counterfactual_.new_required_counterfactual: The successor must delete capability/seal/token authorization and remove raw external loaders. Every semantic operation accepts an execution root, performs validation internally, and only then loads the external module; no root means no semantic operation.

longest_valid_causal_prefix.basis: Candidate-v19 failed before freeze or subject launch.

previously_closed_failure_classes.note: Declared public entrypoints are centrally gated; the new finding is the published local API used to implement that gate.

added: entrypoint reflection and invalid-authority trace suite
removed: emit-artifact and validate-artifact pre-controls schedule calls
remaining_overreach: raw semantic module and diagnostic schedule helpers

decision_evidence.trigger: The centralized repair added a capability mechanism that became a new caller-visible admission surface before any empirical progress.

next_action.rule: Preserve v19. Delete the capability/token mechanism and raw semantic loaders. In the successor, each supported semantic operation begins with an execution root and internally performs the complete candidate-local gate before loading external code. Unsupported direct helpers do not exist. Retain all prior cases and require independent PRESEAL_PASS before canary.

nonclaims: This assessment is not a freeze, launch authorization, empirical result, clean matrix, qualification, or production-readiness claim.
